name: Kinoshita Kurumi
source:
"The Childhood Friend Who Lives Next Door"

A girl who has been close friends with the protagonist since childhood. She’s always been popular with everyone, regardless of gender.

She is in the same class as the protagonist at Seichihiro Academy, and although they reunited after a long time, she along with her classmates treat the protagonist harshly. It seems there might be some reason behind this...

Currently, she apparently has connections in the industry and is aiming to break into show business. She also seems to be working part-time at a maid café, where competition for is fierce.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha01.html]official site[/url]]
